description: This file defines the UrlRedirectRuleDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of URL redirect rules within the OrchardCore framework. It includes methods for rendering the edit view and updating the rule based on user input, with validation for URL patterns.

classes.name: UrlRedirectRuleDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class responsible for rendering and updating URL redirect rules in OrchardCore.

methods.name: UrlRedirectRuleDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the localizer for string resources.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Renders the edit view for a RewriteRule if it matches the URL redirect source.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a RewriteRule, including validation and applying changes.
